recommendation: Keep the source commit as-is. It completes the final BRR decision in active core source; no extension-pack or additional core follow-up was identified for this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-44685 was Applied with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. The issue requested removing FullName from http://hl7.org/fhir/medicinal-product-name-part-type because full medicinal product names belong in MedicinalProductDefinition.name.productName, and the final resolution also required removing LegacyNamePart because neither code is an actual name part type.
initial_application: Commit 467870db39278e10611017291c3e495e320706d2 removed the FullName concept for FHIR-44685 from source/medicinalproductdefinition/codesystem-medicinal-product-name-part-type.xml, but LegacyNamePart remained in the same CodeSystem.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists medicinalproductdefinition as an active resource, and MedicinalProductDefinition.name.part.type binds to the medicinal-product-name-part-type ValueSet that includes the complete CodeSystem. BRR minutes on 2024-10-15 record the 16-0-0 vote for FHIR-44685, and the originating Zulip thread supports the rationale that full-name-like entries should not be used as name part types.
reconciliation: Removed the LegacyNamePart concept from source/medicinalproductdefinition/codesystem-medicinal-product-name-part-type.xml. No ValueSet edit was needed because it includes the complete CodeSystem, and no MedicinalProductDefinition structure edit was needed because the binding remains correct.
